title: Sharp smooth cut-off below the level t (Simon 4.11 cut-off; parent Step 3(v))
statement: For all real numbers t, h, ε with h > 0 and ε > 0 there is a C^∞ function χ : ℝ → ℝ such that 0 ≤ χ(s) ≤ 1 for every s, χ(s) = 1 for s ≤ t − h, χ(s) = 0 for s ≥ t, |χ′(s)| ≤ (1+ε)/h for every s (χ′ = deriv χ), and χ′(s) = 0 for every s ∉ (t − h, t).
lean_statement: ∀ (t h ε : ℝ), 0 < h → 0 < ε → ∃ χ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ ∧ (∀ s, 0 ≤ χ s ∧ χ s ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ s, s ≤ t - h → χ s = 1) ∧ (∀ s, t ≤ s → χ s = 0) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv χ s| ≤ (1 + ε) / h) ∧ (∀ s, s ∉ Ioo (t - h) t → deriv χ s = 0)
